explanation: Rechecking confirms inconsistent nullities. Writing d_k=nullity((B−πI)^k), successive increments d_k−d_{k−1} must be nonincreasing. Since d_4−d_3=5−3=2, each of the first three increments must be at least 2, implying d_3≥6, contradicting d_3=3. The intended subtraction yields 2 (option b), but none of the choices is justified by a matrix satisfying the stated premises.
